title: Rate-Limited Crawler
description: Given a very fast recursive crawler, limit it to at most one page per second while keeping Crawl() concurrent. Add a shared one-second ticker (about 3 lines).
task: Change the code to limit the crawler to at most one page per second, while maintaining concurrency (Crawl() must still be called concurrently).
hints: You only need to add 3 lines.
A shared time.NewTicker(time.Second) will naturally serialize page fetches.
Make sure Crawl(url,...) is still called with the `go` keyword.
starterFails: starter.go fetches pages immediately without any delay, so two crawls happen less than 1s apart
referenceFixes: reference.go adds a shared 1s ticker waited on inside Crawl before each fetch
